task_summary: Develop a cascade machine learning forecasting system using three specialized U-Transformer models for 15-day global weather forecasts

input_specification.source: ERA5 reanalysis data at 0.25 degree resolution
input_specification.input_shape: (2, 70, 721, 1440) - but actual data is (2, 70, 181, 360) at 1 degree resolution

scientific_goal: Mitigate forecast error accumulation and extend skillful weather prediction to 15 days, achieving performance comparable to ECMWF ensemble mean

methodology_requirements.architecture: Cascade of three specialized U-Transformer models
methodology_requirements.key_challenge: Error accumulation mitigation in autoregressive forecasting

required_artifacts: Error growth analysis over forecast horizon
